goal_summary: Preserve the daemon repair, harden PI-5B3G scope validation offline, then run one new bounded campaign.
acceptance_criteria: Lock-safe SIGTERM handler with ordinary-flow cleanup
Automated lifecycle regressions and broader suite pass
Real packaged helper passes parent/child SIGTERM and restart cycles
Deterministic diagnosable child-scope validator passes the adversarial corpus
A new PI-5B3G campaign completes or stops at the first new safety blocker
Exact pushed HEAD and CI evidence recorded

acceptance: Required Ralph state exists and locks the full user goal
tasks.notes: Dedicated worktree created from exact PR #53 head.

tasks.notes: Defective source pattern unchanged from deployed 64a45a3; exact live old process and zero DB accounting revalidated.

tasks.title: Add deterministic old-behavior reproduction boundary
acceptance: A disposable regression test distinguishes unsafe handler work from ordinary-flow cleanup
verification: Focused reproduction test demonstrates the old implementation defect or contract violation
tasks.notes: Deterministic simulated delivery fails old source exactly at Event.set inside handler; disposable subprocess assertion also added and passes on unbundled Python 3.13.

tasks.title: Implement minimal lock-safe SIGTERM repair

tasks.notes: SIGTERM handler now performs only a nonlocal bool assignment; supervisor Event.set and all cleanup run in finally. Five focused tests and Ruff pass.

acceptance: Relevant Python, control, campaign, DB, process, Swift, lint, and broader checks are recorded
verification: Required repository test commands pass or an honest blocker is recorded

tasks.title: Execute bounded PI-5B3G SHADOW campaign
acceptance: Exactly three sequential observations complete with 3 parent, 3 child, 0 retry/fallback/grandchild and zero terminal resources, or a new unrelated blocker is captured
verification: Frozen verifier and authoritative campaign evidence pass
tasks.notes: Historical campaign delegation-campaign-82fe8f1a311044ceb950fe9a659f34ff remains terminal. One parent/zero child, no retry/fallback/grandchild, cleanup and restore passed.

tasks.title: Finalize prior blocked delivery
verification: Evidence commit a85006e and exact-head CI passed

tasks.title: Inventory current dynamic scope validation chain

tasks.notes: External gate is one broad regex plus simple positive checks; production broker has structured authority stripping but no semantic scope validator. Safe negation false-positive risk is proven; historical phrase remains unknown.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic diagnosable scope validator
acceptance: Positive scope proof, safe negation, fail-closed ambiguity, stable sanitized rule trace, and no child-after-reject tests pass
tasks.notes: pi5b3g-child-scope-v2 passes all 44 corpus cases; opt-in broker gate consumes budget and rejects before child construction/port; stable transcript-free trace and fail-closed validator errors are tested.

tasks.title: Verify and remotely checkpoint validator

tasks.notes: Validator commit 64ce05c pushed normally; PR #54 exact head matched; Python, macOS Swift, and OpenCode CI all passed before live campaign transition.
